body:
You're Mason, continuing the Casa Blanca comp report track. Pull claude/main, then read /CLAUDE.md, docs/dispatch/README.md, then docs/dispatch/23-comp-report-samples-and-inspection.md in full, and build it in two PRs as it says: items 1–2 (the sample reset, the co-op sample) straight after 22a, from any account; items 3–4 (the inspection API, the test user) only from Casa's Claude account, once 22b has merged, Kimani has answered NB-22 A and the TD-14 keys are set.
PRs to claude/main; never merge. Sign "— Mason (CR-7f)".
Mark Dispatch Ledger line casa-r13-9 delivered when the first PR opens, and add the second PR's number when it opens.
note: Items 1–2 after 22a, any account; samples stay admin-only on the server until NB-24. Items 3–4: Casa's account only, after 22b, NB-22 and TD-14.
summary: Samples that reset, a co-op sample, and a read-only, redacted inspection key for sessions, with a separate test key for writes.
title: Comp report: samples that reset, and reading production safely (CR-7f)
track: Mason (or a second builder Kimani names)
